testcase.name: bir51_combined_foreign_currency
testcase.description: BIR51 Combined — Foreign Functional Currency (TC + FS)

variation.name: bir51_combined_foreign_currency
variation.description: A complete BIR51 filing where the entity's functional currency is not HKD. Both the TC and FS files use USD (or another valid ISO 4217 code) for monetary facts. NVAD-E-1430 requires FS monetary facts to use the same functional currency declared in the TC file. NVAD-E-1390 requires ProfitLossBeforeTax to match in both files (in the functional currency).
